description: This file provides utility functions for file operations, property reading, string expansion, and directory searching within a software project. It includes functions to read property values from files, read entire file contents, check if a path is a regular file, recursively search files and directories with pattern matching, and expand variables in strings based on property files.

methods.name: bool readPropertyFromFile(const char * filename,const string & property,string & propertyValue)
methods.description: Reads a property value from a file given the filename and property name; supports recursive expansion if the property value starts with '$'.

methods.name: bool readFileContent(const char * filename,string & content)
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: bool isRegularFile(const string & path)
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a regular file.

methods.name: bool searchFilesRec(std::vector<std::string> & pathList,unsigned int currentDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Recursively searches files matching patterns, respecting exclusions, and caps results at 10.

methods.name: bool searchFiles(string & inputPath,int maxDepth,int minDepth,const std::list<string> & exclusions,string & result)
methods.description: Initial entry point for recursive file/directory search with pattern matching and exclusions.

methods.name: bool ExpandPropertiesInString(const char * input,const char * filePath,string & expandedString)
methods.description: Expands variables within a string by reading property values from a specified file, supporting variable substitution.
